column_description: Unique identifier for each access event.
ID of the component being accessed. may be NULL.
ID of the user accessing the component. may be NULL.
Date when the component was accessed. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, edit). always exactly one of 'view', 'edit'. may be NULL.
IP address from which the access was made. may be NULL.
User agent string of the device used for access. may be NULL.
